decisionMetadata.title: AI Governance Harness architecture decision set

asrTriggers.evidence: Default-deny policy enforcement and temporary dependency VEX exception
asrTriggers.note: Policy failure, bypass, identity leakage, or stale vulnerability exceptions would materially change the system risk posture.

asrTriggers.evidence: Repository-owned OWASP Agentic ASI01-ASI10 evidence and governance verification
asrTriggers.note: Evidence must remain explicit, reproducible, and non-certifying while controls and known gaps evolve.

asrTriggers.evidence: Foundry and MCP timeout, circuit-breaker, readiness, and fail-closed behavior
asrTriggers.note: External dependency failure must remain diagnosable without allowing ungoverned execution.

asrTriggers.evidence: Released Toolkit adapter boundary and repository-owned policy contract
asrTriggers.note: Preview API churn and cross-process enforcement require one stable adapter and clear recovery instructions.

asrTriggers.evidence: Deferred hosted identity, sandbox providers, and future Toolkit upgrade path
asrTriggers.note: The local-first architecture must allow later hosted and privileged capabilities without weakening current controls.

untrustedSources.identifier: OSV advisory records for the temporary cryptography exception
